children.game_version: Follow-the-leader line dance focusing on the drag and step-behind movement.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the step and drag while seated, holding hands with neighbors instead of shoulders.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the steps with a support bar, omitting the knee lift.

movement_profile.footwork: Step toward center, drag, knee lift, step-behind-step.

signature_moves.description: Dancers connect by holding each other's shoulders.
signature_moves.name: Shoulder-hold line

signature_moves.description: Step on left foot while dragging the right foot forward.
signature_moves.name: Forward drag

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Steady, transitioning to up-tempo if moving to Hasapiko.

basic_steps: Step toward the center on the left foot while dragging the right foot forward.
Execute a knee lift (high for men, low for women).
Perform a step-behind-step figure moving in the line of direction.
teaching.level_notes: The transition to Teshkoto or Hasapiko increases the difficulty level.
